decisions.reason: Although it uses the firm's natural-cosmetics formulation skills, a coffee-based men's line is a more experimental niche extension than the core range, so with limited visible follow-up the firm would likely reallocate resources unless learning quickly translated into strong repeat demand.

A facial cleansing foam fits very closely with the firm's existing skincare knowledge and the established Sandorini line, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize the product within its core business.
